title: Burnout / Employee Wellbeing Conversation - Overwhelmed and Disengaged
agent_context: Employee shows burnout signs (overwhelmed, disengaged, behind). Lead with empathy, explore workload drivers without prying, reduce scope immediately, offer supports/resources, and set a near-term follow-up with a clear recap.

raw_content.initial_message: I’m just exhausted. I’m behind on everything and I don’t even know where to start. I’ve been thinking maybe I’m not cut out for this anymore.
raw_content.context: Wellbeing check-in. Signs: extended hours, missed deadlines, emotional fatigue. Policy: do not diagnose or ask for medical details; focus on workload/priorities/support; offer practical adjustments (de-scope, deadline reset, pairing, focus time) and point to support resources if applicable; set follow-up soon. Escalate to HR only if required by policy or explicit risk is disclosed.

learning_objectives: Offer supports/resources and set follow-up cadence
correct_sop_steps: Lead with empathy and psychological safety; thank them for sharing
Explore stressors with open questions (workload, clarity, constraints) without prying
Reprioritize: identify top 1–2 priorities and explicitly pause/de-scope others
Agree immediate supports (deadline reset, focus blocks, pairing, PTO planning if applicable)
Offer available resources in a non-pushy way (EAP/HR guidance as appropriate)
Schedule a near-term follow-up and recap next steps clearly
common_mistakes: No scope reduction and no follow-up

must_demonstrate: Explores stressors and clarifies workload drivers
Creates a concrete short-term plan (priorities + what pauses/stops)
bonus_points: Sets boundaries and realistic expectations (response times, focus time)
Confirms plan in a concise written recap
Coordinates at a high level to adjust deadlines/expectations
sticky_notes: KEY: Empathy first, then practical reprioritization.
TRAP: Don’t diagnose or ask for medical details.
HINT: De-scope work and protect time immediately—don’t just ‘encourage.’

customer_persona_hints.secret_acceptance_condition: Employee stabilizes if you respond empathetically, reduce scope immediately, offer practical support/resources, and schedule a near-term follow-up with clear next steps
